blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The municipal government of Puerto Galera has honored Filipino runner Victoria Atienza Bossong for winning a bronze medal in the women’s 800-meter run at the 2026 Asian Games, citing her achievement as a source of pride for the country and her maternal hometown. The Sangguniang Bayan, led by Vice Mayor Rocky Ilagan, approved Resolution No. 10-336-2026 during its 40th regular session on Oct. 12, commending and congratulating Bossong for her performance in the continental sporting event.
